generationInputs.prompt: A mature adult female with fair skin and long, wavy, light gray hair stands behind a countertop in a kitchen. She smiles and looks directly at the camera, wearing light-colored framed eyeglasses, noticeable earrings, a subtle necklace, a gray v-neck top, and a light-colored cardigan. On the countertop in front of her are five pieces of fruit: two speckled orange fruits, one green fruit, and two more green fruits in a teal and brown bowl. Behind her is a light-colored backsplash. Two wooden shelves display various kitchen items including potted plants, canisters, and a metal kettle visible on the left side. The lighting is soft and natural.
